inputs: existing licensed SMPL-H and COCO17 regressor
original S3 analytic camera and pixels, explicitly reconstructed

axes.held_fixed: proxy sigma10, candidate masks, scale, cameras, policy
axes.reference: autograd JVP on four deterministic standardized directions at same anchor; derivative cross-check only

axes.held_fixed: J at 1e-4, candidate masks, scale, cameras, fixed lambda0/lambda_g
axes.additional_control: lambda0 multiplied by precision ratio for metric-only scale invariance; never validation tuning

success: all cells reported, unavailable cells/reasons retained, no silent resampling; JVP relative error<=1e-4 is engineering check, decision changes are reported rather than scored as failures or successes
stop: four steps and three sigma cells only; numerical failures retained, no grid expansion based on desired selection
boundary: cache of random untrained generators; no accuracy, calibration, G1 efficacy or independent truth; G1 fixed at original condition so alternate-Lambda decisions are aggregator-only sensitivity
